entities.name: Akroma
entities.description: A sentient angel illusion created in a dream by Ixidor in the image of his lost wife Nivea, who seeks to avenge her and dies at the Sanctum, giving rise to Karona.

entities.name: Ixidor
entities.description: An illusionist who sacrifices his right arm to shape Akroma and is later swallowed by a deathwurm.

entities.name: Nivea
entities.description: Ixidor's lost wife, killed by Phage in her first pit fight, whose soul becomes the last deathwurm.

entities.name: Phage
entities.description: A pit fighter whose touch brings death, who killed Nivea and is Jeska transformed.

entities.name: Kamahl
entities.description: A barbarian, Phage's brother, who fights her in the Grand Coliseum and swings the Soul Reaper at the end.

entities.name: Zagorka
entities.description: The leader of the Sanctum who leaps into the dome at the final fight.

entities.name: Stonebrow
entities.description: One of Kamahl's former generals who attempts to assassinate Akroma and is converted to her cause.

entities.name: Braids
entities.description: A figure from whom Akroma learned the Patriarch's plan for Phage.

entities.name: The Patriarch
entities.description: A Cabal leader who intended to use Phage as a vessel to conceive his god Kuberr.

entities.name: Cabal
entities.description: A group Ixidor owed gambling debts to that marches against his lands.

entities.name: Locus
entities.description: Ixidor's lands from which Akroma flies forth and later founds a religion.

entities.name: Aphetto
entities.description: The city with the Grand Coliseum where Akroma attacks Phage.

entities.name: Grand Coliseum
entities.description: The arena of Aphetto where pit fights are held.

entities.name: Sanctum
entities.description: A central Otarian city inhabited by Nightmare War survivors and led by Zagorka.

entities.name: Soul Reaper
entities.description: An axe Kamahl wields that slays Akroma, Phage and Zagorka.

entities.name: Karona
entities.description: A goddess born as Akroma dies.

entities.name: Order of Akroma
entities.description: A branch of the Church of Serra worshipping Akroma as a Serra Angel.

entities.name: Nightmare War
entities.description: The war in which Akroma's forces fight the Cabal and Krosan forest.

entities.name: Akroma, Angel of Fury
entities.description: An alternate-reality red Akroma created by a black Ixidor without his arm sacrifice.

entities.name: Echoverse Akroma
entities.description: An Angel of Fury created in Jace's Echoverse by war mage Nivea to avenge her lover's loss.

events.summary: Heartbroken and abandoned in the desert over gambling debts, Ixidor shapes Akroma from his dream at the cost of his right arm, charging her to avenge Nivea.
events.quote: Ixidor gave her but one objective: to avenge Nivea, no matter the cost.

events.summary: Akroma attacks Phage in the Grand Coliseum, but Kamahl interferes and Phage's touch maims Akroma's legs.
events.quote: Akroma had to flee, grievously wounded and maimed as her legs fell victim to Phage's touch.

events.summary: Ixidor heals and enhances Akroma, dreaming a jaguar whose legs replace hers, making her a centaur-angel.
events.quote: Akroma's legs were replaced by those of the jaguar.

events.summary: In the Nightmare War Akroma leads Ixidor's creations against the Cabal and Krosans until Phage releases deathwurms; Nivea's soul swallows Ixidor.
events.quote: The last deathwurm, the soul of Nivea, sought out Ixidor, swallowed him, and escaped as Akroma watched helplessly.

events.summary: Akroma spreads Ixidor's message, effectively founding a religion around him.
events.quote: effectively founding a religion around him

events.summary: Akroma flies to the Sanctum to confront Phage, who says it will be a war of words.
events.quote: Phage claimed that this would not be a war of swords but a war of words.

events.summary: Stonebrow's assassination attempt is foiled and he is converted to Akroma's cause; she then dives into a portal to confront the deathwurm.
events.quote: she jumped into the portal to confront her master

events.summary: The wurm swallows Akroma; inside she finds Ixidor wishing to stay with Nivea's spirit and leaves him, her feet and wings eaten by acid.
events.quote: He wallowed in grief and wished to remain with the spirit of his dear Nivea.

events.summary: Akroma marches on the Sanctum and fights Phage atop the dome.
events.quote: the two women trading blows with one another

events.summary: Kamahl's Soul Reaper kills Akroma, Phage and Zagorka; Akroma dies in peace and Karona is born.
events.quote: Akroma finally died in peace, knowing that Ixidor had been avenged at last.

events.summary: A memorial statue of Akroma holding her sword is built by 4500 AR.
events.quote: a memorial had been built to honor her in the form of a statue of her image that holds her sword

relations.note: created her in a dream from his flesh
relations.quote: She was crafted in his dream and made of his flesh.
created in a dream by Ixidor on Dominaria in the image of his lost wife, Nivea

Phage and her brother, the barbarian Kamahl
